name: Torrid-Inselberg

civilization.name: The Pale Assemblies
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by magnetic pole anomalies near the terminator.
In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
Mining charters include clauses about 'subsurface events' that lawyers refuse to define.
